purpose: Allow the unchanged qualified Lifecycle v1 gate engine to evaluate the current sealed-array parent representation and return receipts bound to the current sealed state_digest identity, without changing lifecycle policy or becoming a second lifecycle engine.

research_gate.reason: Strict repair of already-qualified behavior; no new capability or authority expansion.

external_parent_contract.state_digest_algorithm: Version/Rollback sealState: sha256 of stable parent state with state_digest excluded

collections.manuscripts: key by exact active-compatible manuscript identity; reject duplicate projected keys

projection.state_digest: Excluded from the delegated keyed projection because Lifecycle v1 predates the sealed state_digest field.
projection.losslessness: Every array element must appear exactly once in the delegated keyed projection. Duplicate or missing stable IDs fail closed.
projection.request_ref_rule: Evidence, author-decision and proposal reference strings are preserved exactly and resolved only by their stable IDs.

ledger_bridge.external_binding: bound_parent_state_version/digest equal current sealed parent state_version/state_digest
ledger_bridge.delegated_binding: temporarily replace bound_parent_state_digest with Lifecycle v1 digestParentState(projected_parent) for the unchanged v1 call
ledger_bridge.external_digest: Lifecycle v1 digestLedger applied to the externally bound ledger
ledger_bridge.delegated_digest: Lifecycle v1 digestLedger applied after temporary projected-parent binding

request_bridge.external_expected_ledger_digest: digest of externally bound lifecycle ledger
request_bridge.delegated_expected_ledger_digest: digest of temporarily projected lifecycle ledger

transition_result_bridge.unit_transition: External parent state must remain byte-identical and state_digest-identical; only lifecycle ledger changes are returned.
transition_result_bridge.project_transition: Only book_project.status and state_version may differ from the input current parent; the adapter reseals the current parent with Version/Rollback sealState after applying exactly that v1-authorized delta.
forbidden_parent_delta: any field other than project status/state_version for PROJECT scope

receipt_bridge.version_rollback_compatibility: Adapted receipt pre/post parent identity fields satisfy Version/Rollback authority receipt requirements for authority_kind=LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION.

idempotency.rule: The external request fingerprint is stored in processed_requests; delegated internal digest substitution is not allowed to redefine idempotency identity.

failure_and_atomicity.projection_failure: No delegated call and no mutation.
failure_and_atomicity.v1_rejection: Preserve v1 rejection code; no mutation.
failure_and_atomicity.post_delta_violation: Reject adapter result; no external mutation.

qualification_requirements: Run unchanged Lifecycle v1 predecessor regression suite or an exact behavioral cross-check against all 18 existing cases.
Current sealed-array PROJECT transition PASS with exact current digest receipt.
Current sealed-array UNIT transition PASS with parent byte identity unchanged.
Array export release resolves EXPORT_FREEZE_READY evidence.
Array author decision resolves required author gate.
Array integration proposal refs resolve without authority widening.
Provider direct transition rejects with v1 authority code.
V1 parent delta outside allowed status/version rejects.
Idempotent replay returns same adapted receipt and no double commit.
Version/Rollback accepts adapted project transition receipt as LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION authority identity.
No modification to lifecycle-transition-engine.js or lifecycle-transition-engine-runtime.js.
explicit_non_goals: No new transition or gate semantics
qualification_effect: NONE until exact executable adapter subject passes hosted and registered A-01 qualification. Lifecycle v1 original qualification remains scoped to its original exact SHA.
